items.question: When should I book my bridal makeup appointment?
items.answer: I recommend booking a trial session at least 3-6 months before your wedding date. For summer and spring seasons, book even earlier.

items.question: How long does the makeup last?
items.answer: Bridal makeup is applied with professional products and techniques to last 12-16 hours. It's resistant to humidity, sweat, and tears.

items.question: Do you travel to the venue or set?
items.answer: Yes, I travel to all locations within Istanbul. A location fee applies based on distance.

items.question: Airbrush or traditional makeup?
items.answer: I offer both. We'll decide together based on your skin type and desired look. You can try both during the trial session.

about.title: About
about.headline:
Seeking Art
Within Beauty
story: I see a unique beauty in every face. This belief forms the foundation of my approach to makeup artistry.

Working as a bridal and editorial makeup artist in Istanbul, I aim to provide each client with a one-of-a-kind experience. By blending technical excellence with my personal aesthetic sensibility, I tell your story in its most beautiful form.
With my studio in Maltepe, Kadıköy, and Küçükyalı, I serve clients across all of Istanbul.

philosophy.title: My Philosophy
philosophy.text: Makeup is a tool to reveal the best version of a person. My goal is not to mask beauty, but to deepen what already exists.
